title: Apply mount containment to each operation

context.hint: Apply one read boundary to direct operations and recursive filesystem browsing.
context.surface: A read-only filesystem browser offers direct file operations, directory listing and content search under a configured mount.
assumptions: The configured mount is the read boundary.
Use disposable directories and synthetic files to check the policy.

review.invariant: Direct operations and recursive operations enforce the same resolved mount boundary before accessing files.
review.verification: Check allowed and denied paths through each public operation in a disposable filesystem. Compare the direct read and metadata checks with directory listing and content search.

source_observation.summary: In the local baseline fixture, recursive operations accessed outside fixture content while direct operations denied access. After repair, the recursive operations denied outside paths and ordinary in-root controls passed.
